title: Pack, cost the whole day and sell the batch
course_title: Basic Baking & Snacks Production: Hands-On Small Batches for Sale

say: Pack it, cost the whole day, and sell the batch.
This is the video for module 4 of Basic Baking and Snacks Production.
The most common mistake is packing too soon. Warm snacks release steam, the crust goes soft, and mould grows faster. Fried snacks usually need about 30 minutes on a rack, and loaves an hour or more.

panel.heading: Cool first, then pack
items: Buns: paper or food-grade bags, once cool
Doughnuts: paper, never sealed warm
Bread: bread bag, only when fully cool
Coconut candy: twists, then airtight tub
Fish rolls: box, delivered quickly

say: Sealed warm, the sugar on doughnuts melts and goes sticky.

say: Fish rolls are the exception. Their filling is perishable, so cool them just enough, keep them covered and get them to the customer quickly. Use only food-grade packs, never newspaper or old chemical sacks.

say: Every pack needs these six things, with allergens clearly highlighted. Set your best before date from your own keeping test, a little shorter than the day the product first went off.
Never print a NAFDAC number you have not been issued.

panel.heading: What an honest label says
items: Product name
Ingredients, largest amount first
Allergens in bold: wheat, egg, milk, fish, nuts
Number of pieces or net weight
Date made and best before date
Your business name and phone number

say: Many bakers copy the neighbour's price and wonder where the money went. Cost the whole day instead.
For example, Bisi makes 48 buns and 30 doughnuts, and keeps 2 of each for testing. So she can sell 46 buns and 28 doughnuts.
Ingredients for the four batches cost 8,128 naira.
Then the costs people forget: oil, gas, bags, labels, delivery, and her own 6 hours of labour. Together, 13,290 naira.
The whole day costs 21,418 naira. These are example prices, so always use your own receipts.
Divide the shared costs by the 74 pieces she can sell. That is about 180 naira per piece.

panel.heading: From day cost to a fair price
items: Shared cost: 13,290 / 74 pieces = about 180
A bun costs about 272: priced at 350
A doughnut costs about 318: priced at 400
All sold: 27,300 in, profit 5,882
panel.rule: Divide by pieces you can sell, not pieces you made.

say: Fake transfer alerts are a common scam. Before you hand over goods, confirm the money has arrived in your own account app, however urgent the customer seems.

cards.d: Open your own bank app and see the money arrive. A screenshot or SMS is not proof.
Fish rolls are not held over unless chilled promptly and surely safe. When in doubt, throw away.
No mouldy, stale or damaged packs. Yesterday's bake is labelled and sold apart, at a discount.

say: Do not hold fish rolls over to sell the next day unless they were chilled promptly and you are sure they are safe. When in doubt, throw them away.

say: Never sell anything mouldy or stale, and never re-label old stock with a new date. Bread still within its tested date can be sold as yesterday's bake, at a discount, kept apart from fresh stock.

say: To remember. Cool before you pack. Label honestly. Cost the whole day and pay yourself. Confirm every payment. And keep a daily record of pieces made, sold and left over.
For example, Zainab in Abuja checked four weeks of records before she cut Monday production and added a Friday batch.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Cool before packing; fish rolls go out fast
Honest label with allergens and tested dates
Cost the whole day, including your labour
Confirm every transfer in your own app
Record sales; change only after a pattern repeats
